# OSPFv3 Hello (`ospfv3_hello`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: variable length

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ospfv3`](ospfv3.md) | `type` | 1 (0x01) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `interface_id` | `uint(32)` | `1` |   | Interface ID of the sending interface. |
| `router_priority` | `uint(8)` | `1` |   | Router priority for the DR election (0 = never DR). |
| `options` | `flags(24)` | `0x13` |   | OSPFv3 options (V6, E, N, R, DC, AF bits). |
| `hello_interval` | `uint(16)` | `10` |   | Interval between Hello packets, in seconds. |
| `router_dead_interval` | `uint(16)` | `40` |   | Seconds without a Hello before the neighbor is declared down. |
| `designated_router` | `ipv4` | `0.0.0.0` |   | Designated Router (0.0.0.0 = none). |
| `backup_designated_router` | `ipv4` | `0.0.0.0` |   | Backup Designated Router (0.0.0.0 = none). |
| `neighbors` | `list<ipv4>` — rest of the PDU |   |   | Router IDs of the neighbors seen on the link. |

### `options`

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 (0x000001) | `v6` |
| 1 | 2 (0x000002) | `e` |
| 3 | 8 (0x000008) | `n` |
| 4 | 16 (0x000010) | `r` |
| 5 | 32 (0x000020) | `dc` |
| 8 | 256 (0x000100) | `af` |
